matches.note: BCW Cruiserweight Championship. Xero pinned Ace after a spear, 11:12, to retain.
To become #1 contender for the BCW International Championship. John Varkin pinned James Starr (billed "Starr" in the finish line) after a Dublin Driver, 19:51.
Adam Young pinned Sir Jacob after a Rock Bottom, 9:44.

BCW World Championship. Commander D pinned Alex Austin after a frog splash, 26:19, to retain. Lumberjacks were King, Total Destruction, Killer K and Ryan Wilson for Commander D's corner, and Zamatros, Kai, StingRay and Blaze for Alex Austin's corner.

notes: A fifth match on this same posted document -- SafeCracker defeating Triple J to win "the XWF Championship" -- belongs to a different, unidentified promotion sharing the same board and is not structured as part of this wing's own card; see the served document's own provenance note. SafeCracker is not registered to this wing. Triple J is registered on the strength of his own later BCW tag-match appearance (7-14-08) rather than this match.

matches.stipulation: #1 contenders Match for BCW Triple Crown Title
matches.note: StingRay made Alex Austin submit to the crossface, 20:19.
Commander D pinned Zamatros after a Diamond Cutter, 15:11.
BCW International Championship, billed "Fusion vs. Killer K IV." Killer K pinned Fusion after a K-2, 14:41, to retain.

matches.stipulation: Three way Tag Team Elimination Match
matches.note: Kai & Lan defeated Triple J & Bossman and Thug & Sir Jacob; Lan was the sole survivor.
BCW Triple Crown Championship. Total Destruction pinned Eric Hinz after a People's Elbow, 25:51, to win the title.
